notes: Current USMLE renal content supports acute kidney injury and renal vascular injury.
Merck Manual revised February 2026 supports renal cortical necrosis after pregnancy complications, sepsis/DIC, with abrupt oliguria/anuria and diagnostic imaging.

blueprint.competency: Patient Care: Diagnosis, including history and physical examination

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Postpartum hemorrhage with DIC, persistent anuria, and cortical nonenhancement with relative medullary preservation identifies renal cortical necrosis.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: ATN lacks the defining cortical imaging pattern; papillary necrosis is medullary/papillary, and AIN/renal artery stenosis do not match the obstetric-DIC cortical lesion.
